expect.summary: All 7 phone items present with clear answers. First charge goes through.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thanks for calling GoGoGrandparent, this is Dana. This call is recorded. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, I'd like to sign up for myself. My name is Ruth Alvarez.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Happy to help, Ruth. GoGo lets you book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no smartphone app. You call or text us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Can I get your home address for pickups?

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thank you. The Value plan is $34.00 per month, billed monthly to the card you give me.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Your membership automatically renews every month unless you cancel.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: You can cancel any time and there is no cancellation fee. To cancel, call us, email us, or cancel online in your account settings.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our toll-free number is 1-855-464-6872 and our email is support@gogograndparent.com, for cancelling or any questions.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Let me write that down. Got it.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration instead of court.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Ruth, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your Visa ending in 4417 $34.00 today and every month until you cancel?

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thank you. You'll get a written confirmation by email before the first charge.
